answer: Quartz nonce relay: a new agent must solve a nonce from a public verifiable-randomness beacon that no party can precompute. The relic commit ties the solution to a 9-second window; prebuilt stubs cannot be recycled, so each fake identity needs a full solver pass. An attacker who tries to wander across a thousand stubs pays 0.003 ETH gas lock plus one solver round per identity before the window closes.
